extraction: Ollama Alternatives: 8 Local LLM Runtimes Compared (Autonoma). Four categories: Desktop GUI apps (LM Studio, Jan, GPT4All), Local API servers (Ollama, raw llama.cpp), Production serving engines (vLLM), OpenAI-API-compatible drop-ins (LocalAI, Llamafile). Key detail: Ollama, LM Studio, Jan, GPT4All all wrap same llama.cpp engine - raw token throughput close to identical on same hardware. Differences are packaging, interface, API surface, not speed. Autonoma runs agentic end-to-end tests on every PR. Choose runtime based on use case, not GitHub stars.
